description: Targeted NETWORK mappings for a campaign, looked up directly by the internal numeric campaign_id (point-in-time, no date range). One row per active network target: the campaign_id and the network target_details JSON. Source is the OLTP config table os_ads_db_campaign_targeting_mapping, restricted to network targets that are not deleted (target_type='NETWORK', is_deleted=0). campaign_id is a mandatory filter. Python layer derives networks (list) and network_count from these rows.

campaign_id.description: Internal numeric campaign id the network targeting mapping belongs to. Mandatory filter: pass the internal numeric campaign_id to look up.

target_details.description: The targeted NETWORK definition for this campaign, serialized as a JSON string (TO_JSON_STRING of the target_details struct).

placeholder_metric.description: Constant 0. Row-level dimension passthrough (network targeting lookup) with no aggregated measure; KAM requires at least one metric to fetch.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_ads_db_campaign_targeting_mapping` AS ctm WHERE ctm.target_type = 'NETWORK' AND ctm.is_deleted = 0 AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
